migrations.summary: `pnpm gate`, `pnpm verify` and the other removed commands are replaced by the three test commands.
migrations.instructions: Read "Test runs" in AGENTS.md and "The tiers" in `references/validation.md`. `pnpm gate` and `pnpm verify` with its flags — `--full`, `--timed`, `--perf`, `--quick`, `--no-vitals` and `--extra` — are removed, and so are the `test`, `audit`, `interactions`, `live`, `keyboard` and `vitals` scripts and `scripts/gate.ts` and `scripts/verify.ts`. Run `pnpm test:t1` after a change (the affected Tier 1 tests, the static checks and the type check), `pnpm test:t2` when the change can alter what a page draws or a control does (the affected Tier 2 checks and the browser sweeps as well), and `pnpm test:release` before a release (every Tier 1 and Tier 2 test once, the timed browser suites, lint and the type check). None takes an argument: the command selects the tests. Replace every removed call in the files listed — scripts, workflows, shell files, documents and comments — and read the line each run ends with: it says what ran and what did not. `scripts/verify.config.ts` and `scripts/verify.baseline.json` stay.
